title: Sunday · the corner box, last
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: A landscape Sunday. The cedar mill's smokestack in June. In the corner: COMING 2017 · CEDAR. The last box. Nothing comes.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the abandoned mill from the estuary side in June, wet-on-wet at full mastery: the long shed sagging, blackberry over the dock, the smokestack, swallows. Nobody.

image.prompt: an abandoned cedar mill seen from an estuary in June, the long shed sagging, blackberry over the loading dock, a brick smokestack, swallows, masterful wet-on-wet watercolor, no people

panels.name: The mill

panels.composition: Tier 2: the smokestack close. A cedar sapling growing from its rim, forty feet up. Real — it's there.
props: a cedar sapling at the top

image.prompt: close-up of a tall brick smokestack with a small cedar sapling growing from its crumbling rim against a pale June sky, watercolor
image.notes: The magical-realist run's seed: the tree in the stack is real. The Sundays that follow let it grow.

panels.name: The sapling

panels.composition: Tier 3: the mill at dusk, the sapling a black silhouette on the stack. Bottom-left corner, boxed, the display face: COMING 2017 · A GRAPHIC NOVEL BY A. FINCH · 'CEDAR' · A novel of the timber country.
panels.caption: COMING 2017 · A GRAPHIC NOVEL BY A. FINCH · "CEDAR" · A novel of the timber country.

image.prompt: an abandoned mill at dusk with a small tree silhouetted on top of its smokestack, watercolor, and a small boxed hand-lettered advertisement in the lower left corner
image.notes: The third and last corner box. Same corner, same face. Letter after.

panels.name: The box

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The last corner box. The sapling in the stack is the Cedar run's seed and the ROFLCOPTER mill run's, too.
